sloka: चिछिदुः बिभिदुः च एव राम बाणा गुण च्युताः ।पदातीन् समरे हत्वा हि अनयत् यम सदनम् ॥३-२५-२४॥
transliteration: cichiduḥ bibhiduḥ ca eva rāma bāṇā guṇa cyutāḥ ।padātīn samare hatvā hi anayat yama sadanam ॥3-25-24॥

translations.english: The bodies of the demons torn into pieces by the very sharp iron arrows and by the arrows called vikarni, they cried and shouted aloud in pitiable voices.
translations.hindi: राजपि, सिद्ध, परिकरसहित ब्राह्मण श्रेष्ठ और बिसानों- में बैठे देबतागण, कोतूहलाक्रान्त हो, वहाँ उपस्थित थे
